name: Skybound
description: You, on a pad, with a damaged book.

pages.title: Skybound
pages.text:
You are Skybound: whoever the Loom dropped on a pad with enough grit to stay. The Codex assigns work. You do it. That is the arrangement.

Open the **quest book** for the work. This book is for why, and for what the tribes left in the margins.

pages.title: Nine Strands
pages.text:
Nine Strands still answer if pulled correctly: Soil, Stone, Sprout, Claw, Spark, Clock, Swarm, Sigil, Spindle.

Each one ends in a **Strand token**. A token is proof, not fuel — it is never crafted, never consumed by a recipe. Seat it at a Tension Post and it stays seated.
